title: Desk rules and their evidence (education only, not advice)
sample: 10 paper calls; any result here is promising or not supported, never proven

rules.rule: Exit at -30% from the naming price
rules.evidence: Hit on 5 of 9 closed calls, 6-21 minutes after the call. The two calls named without a stop (php, YAI) lost about 80-86% net. Fast crashes gap through: Pumuckel's realistic fill was near -67% gross.

rules.rule: Take half at 2x; the rest rides the same stop
rules.evidence: Both wins (Arnaud, DIF) came from the 2x half. DIF's runner was stopped 2 minutes after the 2x, so the half-off locked in the win.

rules.rule: A dev sell on its own is no longer a kill
rules.evidence: Approved Oct 22, 2026. Winner Arnaud had a flagged creator sell; winner DIF's dev never sold but a bundle-style dump still hit it. MemeSwap: 'a creator sell is not the same as a rug'; Alphalumina makes the same point.

rules.rule: Survival checks must still pass after the dev has exited
rules.threshold: price >= 60% of high, buyers > sellers, holders rising (minute 3 to 5)
rules.evidence: Replaces the dev-sell kill. Not yet tested on a call named under the new wording.

rules.rule: Kill (or exit) on a bundle or consolidation dump
rules.evidence: The stops on DIF's runner and on Pumuckel both began with one wallet selling far more than it bought on the curve. Bitquery: 21% of launches had dev wallets in the launch bundle; bundled wallets often pass tokens to other wallets that sell.

rules.rule: Kill when the creator is extracting (taking out more SOL than they put in)
rules.evidence: Adopted Oct 22, 2026 with the dev-sell change. Record so far is mixed: the launch checker flagged Arnaud (a win), Pumuckel (a loss) and ship (open), so 1 of 2 resolved flags was a loser. Not measurable on the three token-quoted curves. Under review at 30 calls.

rules.rule: Kill if non-creator wallets bought 30%+ of supply in the launch slot
rules.evidence: Cutoff set after calls 1-6 (all four at 30%+ lost). Out of sample (calls 7-9): 1 loser caught (EKO 37.8%), 1 loser missed (Pumuckel 25.8%), 0 winners killed (DIF 7.8%). ship (24.1%) is open. Promising, not proven.

rules.rule: Score the share bought in the launch slot plus the next two
rules.evidence: EKO 82.7%, FORM 64.9%, php 59.5% all lost; DIF won at 31.7%. Overlaps heavily with same-slot share.

rules.rule: Avoid curves priced in a platform token instead of SOL
rules.evidence: 3 of 3 token-quoted calls lost (GRAIL, YAI, EKO). Tiny sample.
4 of 4 launchpad or platform stories lost (php, GRAIL, MINE, FORM). Story labels are subjective.

rules.rule: Score the dev's past graduations, excluding the coin itself
rules.evidence: Alphalumina out-of-sample: devs with a prior graduation completed later launches at 2.139% vs 0.307%. In these 10 calls it did not separate winners from losers, and two coins' only 'graduation' was themselves.

rules.rule: Score new buyers in the 5 minutes after the call
rules.evidence: Not supported: Pumuckel added 1,130 new buyers and lost; ship added 3 and is up at its mark.

rules.rule: Name calls only at about $15k-$40k market cap
rules.evidence: Not supported as a separator: the two winners were named at $25.9k (inside the band) and $14.3k (just below it), and four of the ten calls were named outside the band. Candidate for deletion at 30 calls.
1 win in 4 AM calls, 1 win in 5 resolved PM calls. No separation.

rules.rule: Treat direct dev-to-wallet SOL funding as the bundle test
rules.evidence: Found 0 dev-funded buyers on all 10 calls, including the ones with probable bundle dumps. Too narrow to rely on alone; kept as one input.

rules.rule: Stop naming calls after 2 stops or zeros in a day
rules.evidence: Would have tripped by about 10:22 IST, and again by 20:30 IST if counted per session, before calls 7-10.
